title: Concept: Workflow requests write-all token permissions in yaml — review required
description: In yaml, permissions: write-all grants the job token every write scope. A compromised action or a script that reads the token can then push commits, publish packages, or edit releases with the repository’s own identity. The declaration is one line and easy to overlook in review, which is why it is flagged even when the job looks read-only.
applicability: yaml workflows that build, test, or deploy from pull-request and branch events.
risk: Privilege escalation through an over-scoped CI token; MEDIUM severity.
